Holding statement — Confirmed: our internal and external reviews have identified systemic safety and control failures affecting multiple facilities and product lines; Under investigation: the full scope, timeline, and root causes of those failures; Regulators have opened inquiries and we are cooperating; we have launched an independent external investigation, paused affected operations where appropriate, and implemented immediate mitigations to protect customers and employees; we regret the impact and will provide updates as material facts are confirmed. 

Q&A framework — Key questions and short responses: (1) What happened? — Confirm systemic control failures; investigation ongoing and no definitive root cause yet. (2) When did leadership know? — We are compiling a verified timeline and will publish it as confirmed. (3) Were regulators/customers informed? — Regulators have opened inquiries; we are cooperating and are reviewing prior disclosures for completeness. (4) Are products safe/what should customers do? — Safety is our priority; we have paused or removed affected items where indicated and will notify customers of any required actions. (5) What remediation/oversight? — Immediate operational fixes, third‑party independent review, strengthened controls, and regular public updates.

Required corrections — Prior public phrases such as “limited in scope” and “quickly contained” are inconsistent with current findings and should be publicly corrected or qualified with a concise statement that our understanding has evolved and directs stakeholders to the investigation updates page. 

Legal flags — Avoid any language implying definitive causation, complete containment, or admissions of liability; have General Counsel review the holding statement, Q&A answers, the proposed correction, and any timeline before release; coordinate messaging to regulators and materially affected customers with Legal and Compliance.
